sources.entry: The GitHub Matrix Screensaver - The GitHub Matrix Screensaver for macOS.

summary.one_liner: A macOS screensaver that shows a Matrix-style animated stream of recent GitHub commits.
summary.what_it_does: The GitHub Matrix Screensaver displays the latest GitHub commits in a Matrix-style animation on Mac OS X. It is based on the author's GitHub Matrix webapp and on Tom Robinson's WebSaver project, which it builds on. Installation is done by double-clicking the bundled Web.saver file in the project folder and selecting Matrix in the system Screensaver preferences. Uninstalling is done by right-clicking Matrix in the same preferences pane and choosing delete. The README gives no details on configuration options or how commits are fetched.
use_cases: Display live GitHub commits as a screensaver on a Mac
Decorative Matrix-style animation for an idle desktop
Show a constant stream of recent public commits on a monitor
Customize macOS screensaver with a web-based visual
how_to_run: Double-click the file Web.saver in the project folder
Open Mac OS X preferences and choose Screensaver
stack: Based on the GitHub Matrix webapp
notable: Runs as a native macOS screensaver built on Tom Robinson's WebSaver project
Derived from the author's GitHub Matrix webapp
Installs by double-clicking the Web.saver bundle
caveats: Binary license components from WebSaver and Senseg Ltd apply
